outcome: successful surgical resection of aortic arch aneurysm
cohort: A single infant diagnosed prenatally with an idiopathic aortic arch aneurysm.
finding: Successful surgical resection of an idiopathic aortic arch aneurysm was performed at 3 months of age following prenatal diagnosis and confirmation in the neonatal period.
followup_time: Up to 3 months (at time of surgery)
